notes: Reproduction of preprod DRIFT finding on prod, against the 89k-project fixture account. RESULT: the 'filter silently ignored at scale' failure mode does NOT reproduce for list_projects's `q` param — q genuinely narrows on prod. q='Demo Project 1' returned info.count=16 (a real fuzzy/substring match set, including 'Demo Project 1', 'Demo Project 12', 'Demo Project 1 v1', 'TM demo project 1', etc.), not ~89k. A nonsense query q='zzzznonexistentproject12345' returned info.count=0, projects=[] (200, not an error) — further confirming q is applied server-side, not decorative. This is the OPPOSITE of the known v2 projects-listing bug (query/search/name/filter silently ignored there); list_projects (v1 route) filters correctly. Unfiltered paging: p=1 -> info={page:1,page_size:30,count:89111,prev:null,next:2}, len(projects)=30, matching page_size. p=2 -> info={page:2,page_size:30,count:89111,prev:1,next:3}, len(projects)=30, and the 30 rows on p=2 are a completely disjoint, chronologically-later slice from p=1 (no repeated ids) — genuine pagination, not a stuck/repeated page. count is stable at 89111 across both pages (close to the documented ~89,102; small delta is expected account churn between when the fixture doc was written and this probe, not a bug). page_size stayed fixed at 30 with no size param, per the declared guidance. Schema drift from preprod REPRODUCES unchanged on prod: `project_creator` (declared boolean field on the shared Project schema) is never emitted on any row (declared_missing) - consistent with the documented 'commented out in the serializer'. The same 8 undeclared-but-always-returned fields from the preprod finding are also present verbatim on prod: thProjectId, test_plans_count, normalisedName, starred, jira_mapped, projectVisibilityBanner, duplicates_tc_count, and info.starred_count. Verdict is DRIFT because the declared-vs-actual schema mismatch (missing project_creator + 8 undeclared fields) is a genuine, reproducible contract defect on real populated prod data - but the critical business-risk question ('are filters silently ignored at scale') is answered NO for this capability: q is honest and functional at 89k-project scale.
